entries.title: Finished Claude conversations no longer stay in memory
entries.body: Infinitary now lets go of a Claude conversation's history once that conversation ends, so its memory use no longer grows with every Claude conversation it has run since it started.
entries.noPicture: This lowers the app's memory use without changing anything on screen.

exclusions.reason: Alpha-only diagnostic: the freeze recorder also writes a local reading of the main process's memory, split between native and JavaScript, with nothing on screen and nothing sent anywhere.
